structure: Part 8 read, at commit 04a073b of the GB-notification-service prototype: the four Design Release 2.1 views roles-and-addresses.html, consignment-address-select.html, consignment-add-address.html and contact-address-for-consignment.html; the four DR2.1 partials consignment-manual-address-fields.html, consignment-uk-add-address-fields.html, consignment-uk-contact-fields.html and consignment-uk-manual-address-fields.html; the data files consignment-address-sections.js, consignment-address-use-groups.js, consignment-addresses.js, contact-addresses.js and address-book-lookup-addresses.js; and the named ranges of app/routes.js (contact address helpers and validateContactAddress 1220-1371, renderContactAddressPage and the consignment address section builder, copy and completeness helpers 2370-2652, renderRolesAndAddressesPage 3201-3220, consignment address search, select and add-address handlers 3843-4283, the manual payload and section sync helpers 9738-9804 and 9843-9865, the GET routes 12644-12663, and the generated section routes plus POST /roles-and-addresses and POST /contact-address-for-consignment 13017-13102). To state what the pages show it also read the helpers those ranges call: the journey step list and getNextJourneyPath (routes.js 1505-1586), the address-use option lists address-book-origin-uses.js and address-book-destination-uses.js, formatAddressBookSuccessMessage, saveAddressBookEntry, getAddressDetailsFromLookup and validateAddressBookManualAddress (routes.js 9651-9935, 10430-10523), the shared journey-form-actions.html partial and the client-side consignment-address-search.js filter. It covers three page families: the Consignment addresses summary at /roles-and-addresses (sections chosen by commodity code, each row's heading, hint, add/change link and the same-as-place-of-origin and same-as-consignee copy buttons, completeness, the unused completeness error messages, and where the buttons lead); the five selectable section pages (place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer, place of destination) each with a select page (search, results table, selection, buttons) and an add-address page (manual entry for origin-side sections, UK address lookup with manual fallback for destination-side sections, every field, the address-use checkboxes, seven validation messages and the two save actions); and the Contact address for consignment page (radio list of branch addresses, the add-a-branch-address link, its one error message and where it leads). The CPH number and permanent address rows are claimed only as they appear on the summary page; their own pages and the address book's own pages are other parts'.

claims.statement: Which address sections the summary page lists depends on the commodity codes of the selected species: the union of each code's section list, in a fixed order (place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer, place of destination, CPH, permanent address).
Commodity code 0101 (horses) shows place of origin, consignor, consignee, importer and place of destination, with no CPH number section.
Commodity codes 0102 and 0103 show the five address sections plus the CPH number section.
Commodity code 01061900 shows the five address sections plus the permanent address section, and no CPH number section.
Commodity codes 05111000 and 05119985 show only the five address sections, with no CPH number or permanent address.
Any other commodity code, or no code, shows the five address sections plus the CPH number section by default.
The permanent address section is removed from the summary unless at least one selected species requires a permanent address, even where the commodity code lists it.
Each section on the summary page is shown with its heading as an h2 and its hint below it, with the hint's bullet list where the section has one.

... If the correct address is not shown, add a new branch address, then return to this page.

claims.statement: The "add a new branch address" link opens the address book's add page with from=contact-address.
When the user adds an address from the contact address page, the address book add is pointed back to the contact address page with the branch address type.

A branch address added from the contact address page is added to the contact address list, selected as the contact address, and the contact address page then shows the success banner "<name> address added to your address book" once.
The contact address page lists addresses as radio buttons: each shows the name as the label and the address lines joined by commas as the hint, with the current contact address pre-selected.
claims.quote: value: address.id, text: address.name, hint: { text: address.addressLines.join(', ') }, checked: selectedId === address.id

claims.statement: The contact address options are, in order and without duplicates: addresses added from this page, address book addresses added in this session with the branch address or contact type, then the prototype's fixed branch addresses.

The prototype seeds three United Kingdom branch addresses for the contact address: Aberdeen Livestock Ltd (15 Union Street, Aberdeen, AB11 5BN), West Country Livestock Ltd (41 Commerce Way, Bristol, BS11 9DQ) and Cymru Animal Imports Ltd (12 Cathedral Road, Cardiff, CF11 9LJ).
claims.quote: name: 'Aberdeen Livestock Ltd', addressLines: ['15 Union Street', 'Aberdeen, AB11 5BN'] ... name: 'West Country Livestock Ltd', addressLines: ['41 Commerce Way', 'Bristol, BS11 9DQ'] ... name: 'Cymru Animal Imports Ltd', addressLines: ['12 Cathedral Road', 'Cardiff, CF11 9LJ']

claims.statement: The contact address page has no search box and no manual address entry of its own; new contact addresses come only through the address book.
claims.quote: If the correct address is not shown, add a new branch address, then return to this page.
claims.note: buildContactAddressResults (search with "Showing" counts) and buildContactAddressFromManual are defined in routes.js, but the DR2.1 view renders only radios; the search helper is not passed to it, and the manual builder is only reached through the address book save.

claims.statement: Submitting the contact address page without choosing an address, or with one not in the list, shows the error "Select a contact address" in the summary and on the radios, linked to #contact-address.
claims.quote: contactAddressId: { text: 'Select a contact address' } }, errorList: [{ text: 'Select a contact address', href: '#contact-address' }]

claims.statement: A chosen contact address is saved as its id plus a text block of the name, each address line and the country on separate lines.
"Save and continue" on the contact address page goes to the next journey step, the review page.
"Save and return to hub" on the contact address page saves the draft and goes to the notification hub.
Outside amend, the contact address page's buttons read "Save and continue", "Save and return to hub" and the link "Cancel and return to hub".
claims.quote: continueText: "Save and continue", hubText: "Save and return to hub", cancelText: "Cancel and return to hub"

claims.statement: While amending, the contact address page shows "Save and return" and a secondary "Save and continue", with no hub button or cancel link.
claims.quote: {% if data.notificationStatus == 'Amend' %} {% set journeyFormActionOptions = { showHub: false, showCancel: false } %}

claims.statement: The contact address page's back link goes to the review page when opened from review, and to the consignment addresses summary otherwise.
The contact address page carries where it was opened from (hub, review or template review) in a hidden field, and with no explicit continue action it returns to the hub or review accordingly.
claims.quote: <input type="hidden" name="from" value="hub"> ... if (isFromHub(req)) { return res.redirect('/notification-hub') } if (isFromReview(req)) { return res.redirect('/review-notification') }

claims.statement: The contact address task is complete when a contact address is saved and still exists in the list; this drives its hub status and the review card "Contact address for this consignment".
claims.quote: return Boolean( sessionData.contactAddress && sessionData.contactAddress.trim() && getContactAddressById(sessionData.contactAddressId, sessionData) ) ... reviewCardErrorState(hasContactAddress(sessionData), 'Contact address for this consignment')

claims.statement: A notification can be submitted only when the review is complete and a contact address is set, and the consignment addresses must be complete for the review to be complete.
claims.note: Read from two lines grep found outside the named ranges; the functions they sit in were not read in full, so the exact gate is inferred.

claims.statement: A request to the select handler for a path that is not a selectable section's path answers "Page not found" with status 404.
The consignor section covers the exporter too: there is no separate exporter section, and the page names only the consignor.
claims.note: Inferred: the section id says consignor-or-exporter, but its heading, link and hint name only the consignor.
